title: Medical Records Request (Release of Information): Amendment Terms by Request Type
content:
Riverbend Regional Health's terms for asking HIM to amend a health record under the Medical Records Request (Release of Information) product: whether a reason must be stated, the grounds on which an amendment may be denied, and what follows a denial or an acceptance.

## Reason requirement, by request type

"Reason required" records whether an amendment request must state a reason.

| Request type | Reason required |
|---|---|
| Patient Access - Electronic Copy | No |
| Patient Access - Paper Copy | No |
| Patient-Directed Transmission to a Third Party | No |
| Authorized Release - Attorney or Legal Representative | No |
| Authorized Release - Insurer or Disability Carrier | No |
| Amendment of Health Record Request | Yes |
| Accounting of Disclosures Request | No |

## Terms that are the same for every request type

These hold identically for all seven request types — Patient Access - Electronic Copy, Patient Access - Paper Copy, Patient-Directed Transmission to a Third Party, Authorized Release - Attorney or Legal Representative, Authorized Release - Insurer or Disability Carrier, Amendment of Health Record Request and Accounting of Disclosures Request.

| Term | Setting for every request type |
|---|---|
| Grounds on which an amendment may be denied | the information was not created by Riverbend; it is not part of the designated record set; it is not available for inspection; it is accurate and complete |
| Statement of disagreement | a patient whose amendment is denied may file a statement of disagreement, which is appended to the record — Yes |
| Rebuttal | Riverbend may prepare a written rebuttal to a statement of disagreement — Yes |
| Notice of an accepted amendment to others | persons the patient identifies are notified of an accepted amendment — Yes |

## Points of judgement

- The list of denial grounds is closed at four: not created by Riverbend, not part of the designated record set, not available for inspection, and accurate and complete.
- An amendment request filed as an Amendment of Health Record Request must state a reason; the table shows "Yes" against that request type alone.
- Each of the three follow-on settings — the statement of disagreement, the rebuttal and notice to persons the patient identifies — is set to "Yes" on every request type.
